description: Convert PDF documents into visually faithful, genuinely editable PowerPoint presentations with a matching print PDF and QA report.

capabilities: Generate print PDF and QA report
defaultPrompt: Convert this PDF into an editable PowerPoint and verify the result.
Rebuild this PDF as an editable PPTX with a print PDF and QA report.
Recover editable slides from this PDF while preserving the original layout.
interface.longDescription: Convert an uploaded PDF into an editable PowerPoint presentation while preserving source text, page geometry, layout, images, and other content as faithfully as practical. The workflow verifies the generated presentation, exports a matching print PDF, and produces a QA report describing fidelity, editability, substitutions, and exceptions.

name: pdf-to-editable-pptx
